title: Resolución de Superintendente N° 018-2020-SMV/02: Reporte de Sostenibilidad Corporativa (sustituye el reporte aprobado por Resolución SMV N° 033-2015-SMV/01)
citation: Resolución de Superintendente N° 018-2020-SMV/02 (Lima, 6 de febrero de 2020), El Peruano 8 de febrero de 2020, OP 1853548-1
evidence: Artículo 5°: "La presente resolución entrará en vigencia al día siguiente de su publicación en el Diario Oficial El Peruano, excepto el artículo 3° que entrará en vigencia el 1 de enero del 2021." The El Peruano search lists the resolution in the Normas Legales edition of 2020-02-08, so the day after is 2020-02-09. Opened https://busquedas.elperuano.pe/api/archivo/file/272ISYruaG39_ADpvQbxa1/*/1853548-1.pdf on 2026-11-02.
notes: Record text is the whole resolution including the new Reporte de Sostenibilidad Corporativa (Article 1, the form with its questions on environment and climate change, social and governance topics). The PDF is a newspaper page set in two columns; the text was cut at the SMV heading and at the OP number 1853548-1, page headers removed, and the form's tables come out as flowed text (answer boxes as 'Sí No'), so table layout is lost. Article 2 makes the report not required for fiscal year 2019; Article 3 (repeal of the second paragraph of Article 3 of Resolución SMV N° 033-2015-SMV/01) applies from 2021-01-01; the record is dated 2020-02-09, the first in-force date. The existing register row pointed at the SMV summary PDF of FY2019 to FY2024 filings (https://cdn.www.gob.pe/uploads/document/file/8034045/6125463-informacion-rsc-2024.pdf), which is a statistics summary and not law. No government English translation is known: the MINAM bilingual publication exists only for DS 010-2024-MINAM. No Quechua, Aymara or other native-language text was found on El Peruano or gob.pe for this instrument. The resolution text was read from El Peruano, not from the SMV site (https://www.smv.gob.pe redirects to gob.pe). A later amendment to the Reporte, if any, was not looked for beyond the El Peruano search for 'Reporte de Sostenibilidad Corporativa' on 2020-02-08.

title: Resolución N° 001-2026-EF/30 del Consejo Normativo de Contabilidad: aprueba la NIIF S1 y la NIIF S2
citation: Resolución N° 001-2026-EF/30 (Lima, 25 de marzo de 2026), El Peruano 27 de marzo de 2026, OP 2500411-1
evidence: No official page opened states a date from which the resolution itself applies. Artículo 2 reads: "El Consejo Normativo de Contabilidad emite las normas y procedimientos relacionados con las normas de sostenibilidad a que se refiere el artículo 1 ... aplicables a las entidades no sujetas a la supervisión ... cuyos ingresos anuales ... sean iguales o mayores a dos mil trescientas (2 300) Unidades Impositivas Tributarias ... las mismas que entran en vigencia a partir del 1 de enero de 2029." Opened https://busquedas.elperuano.pe/dispositivo/NL/2500411-1.data on 2026-11-02.
notes: The brief named an SMV resolution adopting NIIF S1 and S2; the adopting act found is this one, issued by the Consejo Normativo de Contabilidad (Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas). Its single sole final provision tells the SMV and the SBS to issue their own norms for the entities they supervise, which enter into force when those regulators say. No SMV or SBS norm adopting NIIF S1 or S2 was found in the El Peruano search (queries on NIIF S1, NIIF S2, 'Consejo Normativo de Contabilidad sostenibilidad', date window 2023-01-01 to 2026-11-02); the search is fuzzy, so this is not proof there is none. The ISSB standards themselves are IFRS Foundation texts and are not stored; the resolution only approves them and says they are published at www.gob.pe/mef. The record is dated 2026-03-27, the publication date, because the resolution has no commencement clause of its own. No government English translation is known: the MINAM bilingual publication exists only for DS 010-2024-MINAM. No Quechua, Aymara or other native-language text was found on El Peruano or gob.pe for this resolution.

title: Decreto Supremo N° 013-2019-MINAM que aprueba el Reglamento de la Ley N° 30754, Ley Marco sobre Cambio Climático
citation: Decreto Supremo N° 013-2019-MINAM, El Peruano 31 de diciembre de 2019, OP 1842032-2
evidence: The text as published in El Peruano of 2019-12-31 has no commencement clause (Article 1 approves the Reglamento, Article 2 orders publication). Opened https://busquedas.elperuano.pe/api/archivo/file/2mubNpRHaKfBVOvV7ZR2Jp/*/1842032-2.pdf on 2026-11-02.
notes: Reglamento of pe-ley-30754 (72 articles and 20 final provisions). Article 56 creates the Registro Nacional de Medidas de Mitigación (RENAMI), the register whose operation pe-ds-010-2024-minam regulates; Article 55 creates the digital tool Huella de Carbono Perú. The PDF is a two-column newspaper page set; the record text was cut at the sumilla and at the OP number, page headers removed. The text in the PDF ends mid-sentence at the last words of the Vigésima disposición ('en un plazo máximo de ciento ochenta (180) días hábiles'), so it is stored as the PDF gives it. The record is dated 2019-12-31, the publication date. No government English translation is known: the MINAM bilingual publication exists only for DS 010-2024-MINAM. No Quechua, Aymara or other native-language text was found on El Peruano or gob.pe for this instrument.

title: Decreto Supremo N° 010-2024-MINAM que aprueba las Disposiciones para el funcionamiento del Registro Nacional de Medidas de Mitigación (RENAMI)
citation: Decreto Supremo N° 010-2024-MINAM, Separata Especial, El Peruano 12 de noviembre de 2024, OP 2343202-1
evidence: Disposición Complementaria Final, ÚNICA.- Vigencia: "Las Disposiciones para el funcionamiento del Registro Nacional de Medidas de Mitigación (RENAMI) entran en vigencia a los treinta (30) días hábiles, contados desde el día siguiente de la publicación del presente Decreto Supremo en el Diario Oficial El Peruano, a excepción de la Primera Disposición Complementaria Final de las Disposiciones para el funcionamiento del RENAMI, la cual entra vigencia a partir del día siguiente de dicha publicación." Published 2024-11-12, so the first provision applies from 2024-11-13; the rest from the 30th working day after that. Opened https://busquedas.elperuano.pe/api/archivo/file/1IJnm3gAa49APwPHS3oWJJ/*/2343202-1.pdf on 2026-11-02.
notes: Operating rules of RENAMI: categories of mitigation measures, registration, monitoring, verification, issue and use of reduction units (URE), recognition of certification standards. Carbon market instrument; no emissions trading system or carbon tax decree was looked for beyond this one, so none is listed. The Separata Especial PDF holds the decree and the annex (Disposiciones) in two columns; the record text starts at the decree heading, ends at the OP number, page headers removed and fi/fl ligatures normalised; the PDF text layer has a few stray spaces inside words ('l os', 't reinta') that are kept. English: MINAM published a Spanish and English publication on gob.pe (https://www.gob.pe/institucion/minam/informes-publicaciones/6882169-publicacion-bilingue-decreto-supremo-que-aprueba-las-disposiciones-para-el-funcionamiento-del-registro-nacional-de-medidas-de-mitigacion-renami, PDF https://cdn.www.gob.pe/uploads/document/file/8242222/6882169-publicacion-bilingue-renami%282%29.pdf?v=1764013910), translated with GIZ support and marked © Ministerio del Ambiente; row PE-GOBPE-TRANSLATION is permission requested, so the English is not stored. It has no second language other than English. The record is dated 2024-11-13, the first in-force date.
